channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Voices: Whether you’re recreating, hunting or angling, we all share stewardship responsibilities
item.description: “Conservation is only getting more expensive,” writes Caitlin Curry in an op-ed. “If we value access, healthy wildlife populations and the future of Wildlife Management Areas, we must also be willing to invest in them together.”

item.title: Utah’s 2034 Olympics stand apart from other future hosts. Here’s why.
item.description: Utah 2034 Olympics and Paralympics organizers presented a glowing update to members of the International Olympic Committee on Tuesday. That was in stark contrast to some of the other future hosts.

item.title: National chain buys three Utah magazines
item.description: A national publishing company has acquired three Utah magazines that serve foodies, provide wedding inspiration and showcase design and other facets of the region's lifestyle.

item.title: Letter: A vital message for Utah’s congressional delegation: Republicans must stop enabling Trump’s criminal enterprise
item.description: Letter: How many innocent people must be shot, murdered, dragged from their cars and beaten, tear gassed, kidnapped and sent to torture prisons without due process by Gestapo-like ICE thugs before Utah's congressional delegation takes action?

item.title: Letter: Something is changing. Recent protests against ICE and its barbarian tactics are proof.
item.description: Letter: If you’ve been sitting on the sidelines, now’s the time to activate. The times, they are a-changing. This is reason for hope.

item.title: Border Patrol detentions at Utah auto shop spark questions about warrantless arrests
item.description: A video of an immigration-related arrest at an auto shop in West Valley City went viral over the weekend. Here’s what happened.

item.title: Some voters say they were tricked into signing petitions to repeal Utah’s anti-gerrymandering law
item.description: As the Utah Republican Party is gathering signatures for an initiative to repeal Utah's anti-gerrymandering law, some supporters of the law are saying they were tricked into signing the petition.

item.title: How Keyonte George, Lauri Markkanen reacted to the Utah Jazz’s trade for Jaren Jackson Jr.
item.description: Jazz players react to the trade of Jaren Jackson Jr. to their squad on Tuesday.

item.title: A UVU student who saw Charlie Kirk’s last event is ‘totally fine.’ But can her father ethically prosecute Kirk’s accused killer?
item.description: A UVU freshman who attended Charlie Kirk’s campus speech testified Tuesday about the panic she felt after hearing someone yell, “He’s been shot.” Her testimony comes as defense attorneys argue that her family connection to a prosecutor creates a conflict of interest.

item.title: Utah Jazz trade four players, three picks for Jaren Jackson Jr. in stunning deal
item.description: The Jazz made a major move to acquire two-time All-Star Jaren Jackson Jr. on Tuesday.
